reason: I am always hungry for new customers and slow months hurt. Joining costs nothing, so I would test it on a few jobs before deciding anything bigger.
objection: I do not know if real customers will actually come or how many jobs per month I will get. A free sign-up means nothing if the requests dry up.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real, verified requests for my kind of job in Riyadh or Cairo within the first couple of weeks, with a clear monthly number.
